hooks.name: django-system-and-forensic-check
hooks.description: Cross-platform Windows/PowerShell-safe check that runs manage.py check and pytest if backend/manage.py exists

action.command: python -c "import os, subprocess, sys; sys.exit(subprocess.call([sys.executable, 'manage.py', 'check'], cwd='backend') or subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--tb=short'], cwd='backend')) if os.path.exists('backend/manage.py') else print('Django skeleton not initialized yet, skipping check.')"
